transcript.content: Hello, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

Hi, Doctor. It's really nice to meet you, too. Um... well, I'm here because... I guess I just need someone to help me make sense of things? I really hope I'm not wasting your time, I know you're very busy. 

It's just that... for a few months now, I've been trying to get people to understand what's happening, and I feel like I'm not explaining it right. It's about my husband's family. They're... well, they're quietly messing with our money and our good name. It sounds a little silly when I say it out loud, doesn't it? But it's true. Like, little billing errors will show up at my work—I'm a billing clerk, so I notice these things—or someone at church will suddenly act funny toward me, you know? Cold. And I just know it ties back to them, even if the records don't show it right away. I'm just trying to protect my family, you know? Is that... does that make sense to you?
Are you certain your husband's family is doing this to you?

I... oh, I really hope you don't think I'm being dramatic or, you know, vindictive. I really do try to get along with everyone, I promise. But... yes. I am certain. 

Like I was saying about the things at work and the ladies at church... whenever I try to get people to understand what's happening, they look at me like I'm just making a fuss over nothing. And I know that when they pull up the logs or the accounts, it doesn't have my in-laws' names stamped right on it. I completely understand why people might be skeptical at first. But... well, no matter what records anyone pulls up, I just know it ties back to them. They're just very, very careful about how they do it. 

I'm not terrible for thinking that, am I? I really don't want to sound unreasonable to you. I just want to be a good wife and protect what we've worked for... I hope you can understand where I'm coming from.
Have you been hearing voices when no one else is there?

Oh, goodness, no. No, nothing like that. I... I know you probably have to ask everyone those kinds of questions, but I promise I'm not... well, I'm not crazy, you know? It's just my own regular thoughts. 

I really hope I haven't said anything to make you think I'm hearing things. I'm just very stressed about the situation with my husband's family, that's all. I'm answering these okay, aren't I? I really want to be helpful and make sure I'm giving you the right information.
Has anyone been able to convince you that your husband's family might not be doing this?

Well... I mean, my husband has tried. He tells me I'm just working too hard, or that I'm reading too much into a misplaced decimal at the office or a sideways glance at Sunday service. And I really do listen to him, I promise. I don't want to cause trouble or be one of those difficult wives. 

But... I just can't shake it. Even when my boss showed me the system logs, or when my husband says his sister hasn't even been in town... I know it sounds stubborn, and I hate being stubborn, but I just know they're behind it. They're just so careful to cover their tracks. No matter what anyone says or what records they pull up, it all just points back to them quietly trying to ruin our finances and our reputation. 

I know that probably sounds terrible, me not listening to my own husband. I really am trying to be reasonable about it. Does that make me sound awful? I'm just so worried about our family's future, you know?
How long have you been convinced that your husband's family is trying to harm your finances and reputation?

Well, um... I guess it's been going on for about nine months now. 

It all started back when... well, we had a little bit of trouble with his family over some money and, you know, just some expectations around the holidays. I really tried to be accommodating, I promise I did. I always try to keep the peace and make sure everyone is happy. But... well, that's when all of this really started happening with the accounts at work and the whispers at church. 

I hope you don't think I'm just holding onto a silly grudge from the holidays. I know how petty that sounds, and I really don't want you to think I'm that kind of vindictive person. I'm usually very forgiving! It's just that the timing... well, that's exactly when they started doing all of this to us. 

Am I explaining that okay? I really want to make sure I'm answering your questions right and giving you what you need.
Before these problems started nine months ago, did you generally tend to distrust other people and suspect they had harmful intentions toward you?

Oh, no, definitely not. I mean... I've always been a very trusting person. Maybe even a little too trusting sometimes? I really pride myself on getting along with everyone, you know, at the billing office and at church. 

Before all this happened with his family, I never thought anyone was out to get me or anything like that. I always try to see the good in people. I really hope you don't think I'm just naturally... well, suspicious or looking for trouble. Because I'm really, really not. I've always been a team player and I love helping people out. 

Does that make sense? I just want to make sure I'm giving you the right picture of how things used to be. I'm doing my best to be completely open with you, I promise.
Have you had the feeling that someone can put thoughts into your mind that are not your own?

Oh, goodness, no. No, I've never felt anything like that. That sounds... well, that sounds very frightening, actually. 

My thoughts are definitely my own, I promise. I know I've been talking a lot about how his family is interfering with our lives and the accounts, but they aren't doing anything... you know, inside my head. It's all things they're doing out in the world, behind the scenes. 

I hope you don't think I'm losing my mind or anything like that. I know the things I'm saying about his family probably sound very strange to you, but I'm completely in control of my own thoughts, I assure you. I'm just a regular person trying to figure out why they're doing this to us. 

Is that the kind of thing you need to know? I really hope I'm being helpful. I don't want you to think I'm keeping anything from you, because I'm really trying to be as honest as I can be.
Have you ever felt that your thoughts were being broadcast so that other people could know what you were thinking?

Oh, no, no, not at all. I mean... I know what I'm thinking, but nobody else does unless I tell them. 

That would be... well, that would be awful, wouldn't it? If everyone just knew what you were thinking? No, I've never experienced anything like that. Like I said, the things his family are doing, it's all very... practical things. Meddling with the accounts and talking to people at church. It's nothing... supernatural or anything like that. 

I really hope I'm not giving you the wrong impression with all of this. I know I'm upset about his family, but my mind is perfectly sound, I promise. I'm just a normal person dealing with a very difficult situation. 

Did I answer that right? I just want to be sure I'm giving you exactly what you're looking for.
During the time this has been going on, have you been feeling persistently depressed?

Oh, depressed? No, I wouldn't say that. I mean... I have my days where I feel a little overwhelmed by everything, of course. Who wouldn't, with all this stress from his family? But I'm definitely not depressed. 

I still get up every morning, go to work, go to church... I try to keep a smile on my face and just keep moving forward. I'm actually a very positive person, usually. I always try to look on the bright side of things. It's just... well, it's just been a bit of a difficult stretch lately, that's all. 

I really hope you don't think I'm just sitting around feeling sorry for myself, because I'm absolutely not. I'm doing my best to handle everything as well as anyone could. 

Is that what you mean by depressed? I hope I'm answering these questions the right way for you. I just want to make sure I'm giving you the information you need.
Have you ever seen things that other people could not see?

Oh, goodness, no. No, I've never seen anything that wasn't really there. 

I know some people have those kinds of... well, those kinds of issues, and I feel for them, I really do. But my eyesight is perfectly fine, and I only see what everyone else sees. Like when I saw his sister's car parked down the street from my office last week—anyone could have seen it, it was right there in broad daylight. 

I'm a very grounded person, Doctor. Working in billing, you have to be very detail-oriented and focused on the facts, you know? You can't be imagining things when you're dealing with numbers and accounts all day. 

I hope that's a good thing, that I don't see things? I'm just trying to be a good patient and give you the right answers. I'd hate for you to think I was... you know, seeing visions or anything like that. I'm completely normal in that way, I promise.
